name: Mirror Correction Euler
plain: Same family as Kohaku Yog: in an early phase it evaluates at a reflected state and at a point one averaged-slope step ahead, both at the same sigma. It reflects about the x0 estimate rather than negating the latent. Norm limits stop the probes from exploding.
math: If progress<correction_phase: x_p=2x0−x; d_p=(x_p−model(x_p,σ))/σ, limited to 5|d|. x₃=x+((d+d_p)/2)dt, dt=σ↓−σ. d₃ at x₃ with σ unchanged, limited. d=(d+d₃)/2. x=x+d·dt+n·s·σ↑. Smooth phase: d←d+w((d+d₃)/2−d), w=√t, t a log σ ramp.
label: from code

audit.note: adept_samplers.py:430,448: x₃ is a full step along the averaged slope, not a midpoint. Smooth phase does more than gate: lines 417-439 blend d←d+w(d_heun−d), w=√t, t a log σ ramp. Binary mode zeroes d on NaN/Inf (455); dt=σ↓−σ.
